---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |> 
  filter(Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |> 
  group_by(Activity) |> 
  filter(n() >= 50) |> 
  ggplot(aes(y = Activity, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal vs Non-Fatal Shark Attacks by Activity",
    x = "Number of Attacks",
    y = "Activity",
    fill = "Outcome"
  )
```
